gates.title: Age 16 — optional paid skill
items: Allergy kitchen trial done (~20 shifts) or kitchen path rewritten
If second node is NSW and energy allows: assistant-agent course vs leave it
Methods T / NSW Advanced still on the Year 11 form
Hour cap agreed for Year 11 (default <=12 if chasing ATAR)

gates.title: Age 17 — Year 12 package lock
items: AST / HSC exam plan is real, not hoped
One side-skill only
College careers adviser has signed the live package
Family-file conflict named if D + E + books are all on

gates.title: Age 18 — adult tickets
items: CA-accredited bachelor or CIT Cert IV bridge or CA Fundamentals + ATE job
ACT real-estate licence now legally possible
NSW Class 2 only after assistant time + qual
Independent chef contracts only if 18+ and insured
NSW conveyancer study may start; ACT standalone licence still does not exist

gates.title: Age 20 — identity review
items: Keep or drop chef and real estate as owned fallbacks
WAM / TES / bridging result vs primary path by 23
R&D incentives only inside a supervised team
Housing node for the rest of the degree confirmed

gates.title: Age 23 — professional on-ramp
items: CA practical experience clock running, or tax-law units for Item 201
Adviser exam only if Path C is still the identity
NSW conveyancer clock or PLT if E-Law
One professional ticket in reserve

gates.title: Age 27 — win condition check
items: Pick the actual win: CA/tax agent, licensed agent, NSW conveyancer/solicitor, or insured operator
Not agent + conveyancer + tax agent on the same family file
P&L clean enough to show a referee
Next decade housing node is a choice
